therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Frequency of patients with adverse events at 54 weeks

biomarker_changes: HbA1c change at week 54 (54-week baseline): M1000 -0.06%, L2.5+M500 -0.28%, L2.5+M1000 -0.24%
HbA1c change at week 78 (78-week baseline): M1000 -1.25%, L2.5+M500 -1.32%, L2.5+M1000 -1.63%
FPG change at week 54: M1000 -6.02 mg/dL, L2.5+M500 -7.24 mg/dL, L2.5+M1000 -9.82 mg/dL
DBP change at week 54: M1000 -0.3 mmHg, L2.5+M500 -0.1 mmHg, L2.5+M1000 +0.3 mmHg
SBP change at week 54: M1000 +0.6 mmHg, L2.5+M500 -0.2 mmHg, L2.5+M1000 +2.2 mmHg
subgroup_findings: L2.5+M1000 showed greatest HbA1c reduction at 78 weeks (-1.63%) and lowest rescue therapy use (24 patients)
safety_signals: Withdrawals due to AEs: M1000 10, L2.5+M500 11, L2.5+M1000 9
Cardiogenic shock (1 patient) and supraventricular tachycardia (1 patient) in L2.5+M1000 arm
Serious cardiac events including acute myocardial infarction across arms
Triglyceride abnormality >300 mg/dL: M1000 14, L2.5+M500 14, L2.5+M1000 10

dose_info.dose: Linagliptin 2.5 mg + metformin 500 mg or 1000 mg; metformin 1000 mg
